description: A customer concentration schedule: one or more tables listing an organization's largest customers with the revenue from each over several fiscal years, a total for the listed customers and that total as a share of revenue. Each table (exhibit) is extracted as one schedule.

reporting_entity.description: Name of the organization whose customers are listed, as printed in the page header, e.g. 'District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority'.

schedules.description: One entry per concentration table in the document, in the order they appear. A table that continues across pages is one schedule.

exhibit_number.description: Exhibit, schedule or table number as printed, e.g. '6'. Null if the table is unnumbered.

schedule_title.description: Title of the table as printed, joining its title lines, e.g. 'Ten Largest Commercial Customers, Last Ten Fiscal Years'.

customer_category.description: The class of customer the table covers, taken from the title, e.g. 'Commercial' or 'Government'. Null if the title names no category.

amount_units.description: The unit the amounts are stated in, as printed under the title, e.g. '$000' for thousands of dollars.

most_recent_fiscal_year.description: The latest fiscal year column in the table, e.g. 2025.

customers.description: Every customer row in the table, in printed order, excluding the total and percentage rows.

customer_name.description: Customer name exactly as printed in the first column.

most_recent_year_amount.description: Amount in the most recent fiscal year column, as printed in the table's units (do not scale thousands). Null, never 0, if the cell shows '-' (the customer was not among the largest that year).

prior_year_amount.description: Amount in the fiscal year column immediately before the most recent one, in the table's units. Null, never 0, if the cell shows '-'.

yearly_totals.description: One entry per fiscal year column, from the Total row and the percentage-of-revenue row beneath it.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year of the column, e.g. 2025.

total_amount.description: The Total row's amount for this year, in the table's units (do not scale thousands).

percent_of_total_operating_revenues.description: The '% of Total Operating Revenues' (or similar share-of-revenue) value for this year, as a percentage number, e.g. 3.69 for '3.69%'.

data_source.description: The source note printed beneath the table, without the 'Source:' prefix, e.g. 'DC Water Department of Customer Service'.
